doc: bilinear algorithms for multiplication in F2[x]/(h) (h = p^e, p irreducible), key = h as integer; dec = list of (alpha, beta, gamma) masks over the coefficients of the residue ring; c = sum (alpha.a)(beta.b) gamma mod h.  Pruned from the qoptct lab (k5) table to the places used by the optimal CRT plans for 2 <= m <= 600 (plus all x^e).  Every entry is re-checked on load.
